csv_scope_of_work: The City of Parkston, South Dakota, will accept statements of qualifications (SOQ) from qualified engineering firms for engineering services for proposed development on the Parkston Municipal Airport. Engineering Services for the following projects listed on the CIP for a period of up to a maximum of five years from 2026 through 2030. Design and Construction Services for Runway Rehabilitation with Lighting and Fencing Improvements Design and Construction Services for Apron Reconstruction Design and Construction Services for Hangar Taxi lane Expansion Design and Construction Services for AWOS III Design and Construction Services for Revenue Producing Hangar
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Utility Engineering, Transportation Planning
title: Airport Engineering Services
short_description: Engineering services for phased development projects at Parkston Municipal Airport through 2030.
project_scope: Multi-project airport development program at Parkston Municipal Airport for 2026-2030, including runway rehabilitation with lighting and fencing improvements, apron reconstruction, hangar taxilane expansion, AWOS III installation, and a revenue-producing hangar.
services: Engineering design and construction services for airport infrastructure projects; disciplines requested include rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, utility engineering, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Airport civil engineering program, not a bridge, special structure, sports venue, or architecturally demanding building.
- Scope is dominated by airside infrastructure, utilities, and multidisciplinary airport engineering.
- No clear structural engineering focus aligned with sbp's core profile.
- Includes geotechnical, MEP, and planning-related services that are outside primary sbp interest.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The notice lists runway rehabilitation, apron reconstruction, taxilane expansion, AWOS III, and a hangar, but provides no quantities, areas, dimensions, or cost figures to support a realistic estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the source, and the tender is for broad engineering services over up to five years without a stated budget basis for estimating an sbp fee.
references_qualifications: Statements of qualifications from qualified engineering firms for airport engineering services; no specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
contracting_authority: City of Parkston, South Dakota; Contact: Austin Tilton; Phone: 605-928-3321; Fax: 605-928-7968; Email: austin@cityofparkston.org
notes: RFQ/SOQ for a renewable period of up to 60 months, covering CIP projects from 2026 through 2030. Solicitation documents available by contact. Category assigned as Buildings only because the fixed list does not include airport infrastructure; however, the project is primarily transportation/airport civil works rather than a building-focused tender.
